description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade logic for a device. It defines functions to check the image and perform the upgrade, determining behavior based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function to check the validity of the firmware image. Always returns success in this implementation.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade based on the detected board name, invoking different upgrade methods depending on the board identifier.
